snippet.title: Gorf the Ghost Saves Halloween - Trailer
snippet.description:
The trailer for my very first game!

Available at https://dashrando.itch.io/gorf-the-ghost-saves-halloween

A Gameboy game where you play as Gorf the Ghost. It's Halloween but everyone is too scared to trick or treat because of an evil skeleton in the graveyard. Explore the town, help your friends, and save Halloween!
